faq.question: What is Legend Mod?
faq.answer: Legend Mod is a browser client and Chrome extension that adds custom skins, themes, configurable controls, multiboxing, replays, and many other features to Agar.io-style cell games. It is not a game itself.

faq.question: Is Legend Mod the same as Agar.io?
faq.answer: No. Legend Mod is a separate extension/client project. Agar.io is a game by Miniclip. Expanding Land is a separate independent game. These are three distinct entities.

faq.question: Is Expanding Land the official Agar.io service?
faq.answer: No. Expanding Land is an independent multiplayer cell game built from scratch in C. It is not affiliated with Agar.io or Miniclip.

faq.question: Does the Expanding Land map change?
faq.answer: Yes. The server controls expansion and contraction of the circular arena. The map scale ranges from 0.25x to 8x based on player activity.

faq.question: Are all opponents in Expanding Land human?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Human and server-controlled bot counts vary by arena. In-game counters distinguish the populations.

faq.question: What is the maximum player count?
faq.answer: Expanding Land supports up to 3,840 simultaneous players per arena. Actual counts depend on server configuration.

faq.question: How do I install Legend Mod?
faq.answer: Install the Legend Express Chrome extension from the Chrome Web Store, or visit legendmod.ml/play.html to use the web client directly.

faq.question: What languages does Legend Mod support?
faq.answer: 16 languages: Arabic, Bulgarian, German, Greek, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian (beta), Italian (beta), Japanese (beta), Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (beta), Russian, Turkish, and Traditional Chinese.

faq.question: Is Legend Mod free?
faq.answer: Yes. Legend Mod and Expanding Land are free to use with no subscription required.

faq.question: Does Legend Mod collect personal data?
faq.answer: The Chrome extension does NOT collect, store or transmit personal data externally. See the privacy policy at legendmod.ml/privacy.html.

faq.question: What mods are compatible with Expanding Land?
faq.answer: Legend Mod (legendmod.ml), Delta Mod (deltio.pages.dev), and Agar2 (agar2.com) are compatible client mods.

faq.question: How do I spectate in Expanding Land?
faq.answer: Press Escape while alive to enter free spectate. Up to 200+ spectator slots with free-roam camera. Click the minimap to move the camera.

faq.question: What is the dynamic map?
faq.answer: Expanding Land's circular arena auto-resizes from 0.25x to 8x based on player count. The server controls expansion and contraction of the boundary.

faq.question: What is a scan trick?
faq.answer: A movement technique: while its key is held the cell heads far out toward the cursor at the exact angle; with the left mouse button held too, the direction snaps to one of 16 (22.5 degrees each). It has no settings.

faq.question: What is line split?
faq.answer: A rapid multi-split technique (x8 or x16) in a straight line toward the cursor with configurable timing and lock duration.

faq.question: What is the Practice Arena?
faq.answer: An offline mode with 8 exercise types (free, split, virus, dodge, path, escape, feed, merge) where you practice against bots without connecting to a server. Personal bests and ghost replay of your best run.

faq.question: How do I save my own themes?
faq.answer: Part of the Theme presets in the Theme tab: under the Theme preset list, save the current theme under a name (up to 30), apply one by picking it, Update it with the current theme (the last 5 versions are kept and an older version can be picked to bring it back) or delete it. Kept in this browser; Export / Import settings carries them. Values are checked against the theme schema; URLs must be HTTPS.

faq.question: What are Settings Profiles?
faq.answer: Named sets of all gameplay and visual settings (up to 30 profiles) that can be switched instantly. Auto-switching per server type, game mode or input device. 5 automatic backups.

faq.question: What are Custom Macros?
faq.answer: 3 macro slots for automated action sequences (split, feed, wait, move) with up to 24 steps each. Dry run mode available. Safety timing limits enforced.

faq.question: What are User Scripts / Plugins?
faq.answer: 5 script slots for custom JavaScript extensions with plugin header format, settings API (up to 20 settings), version compatibility checking, and a catalogue of example plugins.

faq.question: What is the death recap?
faq.answer: A Game Over card feature showing the last 20 seconds of your life as 3-6 summarised steps with a mass sparkline, plus the killer's name and mass.

faq.question: What is the Danger Zone?
faq.answer: The outer ring during Expanding Land map contraction. Being in it adds +0.01 to the anti-teaming multiplier per cycle, discouraging camping at the edges.

faq.question: How is Expanding Land different from Agar.io?
faq.answer: Expanding Land has a dynamic circular arena (not fixed square), is built from scratch in C (~5ms tick), supports 3,840 players per arena, has 200+ spectator slots, anti-teaming and coordinate scrambling anti-cheat, and is by an independent developer (not Miniclip).

faq.question: How do I use a gamepad?
faq.answer: Connect any standard gamepad (Xbox, PlayStation, etc.) and Legend Mod auto-detects it. Go to Settings → Controls → Gamepad to customise mapping, dead zone, response curve and vibration. The left stick controls movement and buttons map to split, feed and macro actions.

faq.question: What is the Theme Bridge?
faq.answer: The Theme Bridge (lm-theme-bridge.js) lets standalone pages (skins gallery, features, FAQ, monitor) share Legend Mod's active theme. It reads the user's saved theme from localStorage and applies it, so every page matches the in-game look.

faq.question: How do I export or import settings?
faq.answer: Open Settings → Profiles → Export to save all your settings, themes and player profiles as a JSON file. Use Import to load them on another device. Settings Profiles (up to 30) can also auto-switch per server type, game mode or input device.

faq.question: What is the LMEvents API?
faq.answer: LMEvents is a JavaScript event bus that user scripts and plugins can use to listen for game events (cell eaten, mass changed, game over, server switch, etc.) and react without modifying core code. See the developers documentation for the full event list.

faq.question: How do I multibox?
faq.answer: Enable multiboxing in Settings → Connections. You can run up to 4 connections with colour-coded cell rings. Use the tab key (default) to switch active connections. A middle-camera view shows the averaged position of all your cells.

faq.question: What games does Legend Express support?
faq.answer: Legend Express (the Chrome extension) works with Agar.io, Expanding Land, Agarix.com, and Cellcraft.io. The web client at legendmod.ml/play.html connects directly to Expanding Land servers.

faq.question: How does mass decay work in Expanding Land?
faq.answer: Cells lose approximately 0.8% of mass every 4 seconds. Bigger cells decay proportionally faster, making extreme size difficult to maintain. The anti-teaming system can accelerate decay further via its exponential multiplier.

faq.question: How does the merge timer work?
faq.answer: After splitting, cells cannot recombine immediately. The timer depends on each cell's mass — bigger cells take longer to merge. Legend Mod shows a countdown overlay and progress rings on your cells, plus an optional sound alert when cells are ready to merge.

faq.question: What game modes does Expanding Land have?
faq.answer: Free-for-all (FFA) for competitive solo play, Teams for team-based play with assigned colours, and Experimental/Battle Royale modes on select arenas. Mode 5001 is a private server mode.

faq.question: What server regions are available?
faq.answer: US-Atlanta and EU-London are the primary regions. Private servers (mode 5001) can also be hosted. The monitor page at legendmod.ml/monitor/ shows all active servers and their regions in real time.

faq.question: What is the Player Monitor?
faq.answer: A live dashboard at legendmod.ml/monitor/ showing all online players, their servers, regions, game modes, levels, countries, and last seen times. It includes a History page for tracking player activity over time.

faq.question: How do I log in to Expanding Land?
faq.answer: Discord OAuth and Google Sign-In are supported for account features (level, stats, name history). Guest play requires no login — you can play immediately with any nickname.

faq.question: Can I play on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes. Expanding Land supports PWA with fullscreen landscape play and screen wake lock. An Android APK is also available. Legend Mod's mobile touch controls provide on-screen buttons for split, feed, and movement.

faq.question: What is coordinate scrambling?
faq.answer: An anti-cheat system where each connected player receives unique random coordinate offsets from the server (scramble_x, scramble_y, scramble_id). This prevents external tools or bots from sharing exact player positions between accounts.

faq.question: How does the anti-teaming system work?
faq.answer: It uses an exponential decay multiplier (Delta Server-style): decay = base × pow(1.086, multiplier). Actions like W-pressing (+0.1), splitting near allies (+0.5), virus popping (+0.5), and sitting in the Danger Zone (+0.01/cycle) increase the multiplier. Recovery is -0.005 per cycle. In Teams mode, eject loss is set to 0.

faq.question: How do viruses work?
faq.answer: Viruses are spiky green circles. Big cells pop into ~16 pieces when touching one. Small and medium cells pass through safely. Feed 7 W-presses into a virus to shoot it toward another player (~100-110 mass cost). This is a key offensive tactic called a virus shot.

faq.question: What is the Replay Studio?
faq.answer: A full playback tool for game replays with timeline, automatic bookmarks, variable speed (0.25x-4x), pause, packet-by-packet stepping, forward/backward seeking, and timeline scrubbing. Replays are saved as .lm files and stored in IndexedDB.

faq.question: What is the HUD Editor?
faq.answer: A tool to drag and resize 15 HUD components (leaderboard, minimap, stats, chat, etc.) into named layouts. Up to 20 layouts with grid snapping (8/16/32px), lock/unlock, and edge-relative positioning for responsiveness.

faq.question: What is the Analytics Dashboard?
faq.answer: A statistics window with a dashboard (games, highest mass, survival, top-10 rate, weekly chart, best servers and modes), heatmaps and the match history, from up to 500 game summaries. It tracks position history (3,600 samples per game, 50 games).

faq.question: How do presets work?
faq.answer: Legend Mod offers one-click presets: Competitive (enables rings, mass, split range), Battery Saver (caps FPS, disables effects), Streamer (hides personal info), Reduced Motion (no animations), and Clean HUD (minimal interface). Theme presets include 8 colour schemes.

faq.question: What is ghost cells?
faq.answer: An Expanding Land-exclusive feature. When you die, a transparent cell appears at your death location, visible on the minimap. Ghost cells help you track where deaths occurred and avoid dangerous areas.

faq.question: How do sound controls work?
faq.answer: Settings > Sounds has each sound's switch, sound file and volume: chat message and command sounds (with their volumes), the virus sound (a virus is shot, or you pop or eat one), the 16 pieces sounds, a gameplay effects volume and a master volume (0-100%) that also scales the video skins (their own level is in Settings > Skins).
